column1: # Blackout team band per torso model: where and how (paint = the sleeve's own texels in a
# per-material diffuse variant; shell = an extra part on the sleeve's faces). Windows are
# fractions of the upper arm from the shoulder joint (Arm) to the elbow (ForeArm), planes
# square to it. Drafted by the automatic check (bandlib/sweep); edit window, method and
# rules per row, status good|adjusted|problem after review.
# visible_cloth/covered/stretch/tilt are from the face-level sweep at the same window.

column8: selection_rule
